description: This PHP source file defines the class 'tlExtTable', a helper for rendering and managing extended JavaScript tables within a web application, specifically used for generating Ext JS GridPanels with custom configurations, behaviors, filters, and rendering options.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A helper class to generate configuration and scripts for Ext JS GridPanel tables, with support for custom rendering, sorting, filtering, and export functionalities.

methods.name: addCustomBehaviour
methods.description: Registers custom rendering and sorting behaviors associated with specific column types to enable flexible table rendering.

methods.name: buildContent
methods.description: Creates a JSON-encoded JavaScript array representing the table's data content.

methods.name: buildColumns
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript array defining the configuration of table columns for Ext JS, including headers, data bindings, filters, and custom renderers.

methods.name: buildFields
methods.description: Constructs a JavaScript array defining data fields for Ext JS stores, including sorting types for custom columns.

methods.name: buildCodeLabels
methods.description: Creates JavaScript code for label mappings of status, priority, and importance codes used in the UI rendering.

methods.name: renderHeadSection
methods.description: Outputs the JavaScript necessary to initialize the table's data, fields, and columns in the page.

methods.name: renderCommonGlobals
methods.description: Outputs common JavaScript variables and labels used across multiple tables and scripts.

methods.name: renderBodySection
methods.description: Outputs the HTML div container that will host the JavaScript-powered table.

methods.name: buildCfg
methods.description: Builds JavaScript configuration for status code ordering used in filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getColumnIdxByName
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the index of a column given its (localized) name.

methods.name: setGroupByColumnName
methods.description: Configures the table to group rows by the specified column name.

methods.name: setSortByColumnName
methods.description: Sets the default column for sorting based on its name.

methods.name: buildStatusFilterOptions
methods.description: Generates JavaScript filter options for status codes.

methods.name: buildPriorityFilterOptions
methods.description: Generates JavaScript filter options for priority levels.

methods.name: buildImportanceFilterOptions
methods.description: Generates JavaScript filter options for importance levels.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets image assets used by the table's UI actions.

methods.name: getGridViewConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration string for the grid view, including layout and grouping.

methods.name: getDisableUserJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript for disabling user action controls, including confirmation dialogs and tooltips.
